LanguageData.LP_ALP_Healing.label: elixir of healing
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Healing.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. Drinking it stops all bleeding and instantly heals 20 points of wounds. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs heal ×1.3.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Swift.label: elixir of swiftness
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Swift.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. For 1 day movement +25%. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs last ×1.3 as long.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Tough.label: elixir of resilience
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Tough.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. For 1 day damage taken -15%. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs last ×1.3 as long.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Light.label: elixir of lightness
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Light.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. For 1 day walking ignores slowdown from terrain, snow and plants. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs last ×1.3 as long.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Lucid.label: elixir of clarity
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Lucid.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. For 1 day consciousness +10%, no sleepiness. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs last ×1.3 as long.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Courage.label: elixir of courage
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Courage.description: An alchemist's experimental elixir. For 1 day mood +10, mental break threshold -5%. Anyone can drink it; spoils in 3 days. Refined elixirs last ×1.3 as long.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Restorative.label: restorative reagent
LanguageData.LP_ALP_Restorative.description: An alchemist's restorative reagent. Drinking it cures the worst disease on the body (flu, plague, malaria, sleeping sickness, gut or muscle parasites, fibrous / sensory mechanites, food poisoning, wound infection, lung rot); with no disease it clears toxic buildup. Anyone can drink it; never spoils.
LanguageData.LP_ALP_GreaterRestorative.label: elixir of greater restoration
LanguageData.LP_ALP_GreaterRestorative.description: An elixir a master chemist can only make one of per quarter. Drinking it regrows a missing limb or organ (the biggest one) and clears all diseases, addictions and toxic buildup. Anyone can drink it; never spoils.
LanguageData.LP_RuneMine.label: rune mine
LanguageData.LP_RuneMine.description: A rune buried by a Fortress Engineer: an enemy stepping on it takes 20 × artifice power arcane force damage and falls for 2 seconds, then the rune dissipates. Hidden in the ground, hard for enemies to notice.
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCapacitor.label: arcane capacitor
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCapacitor.description: A Fortress Engineer's rune capacitor: needs no fuel and always outputs 300 W. Turrets within 3 cells get +15% fire rate. Each engineer who knows "arcane capacitor" can support at most artificer level ÷ 3 of them (colony-wide total).
LanguageData.LP_FortressCore.label: fortress core
LanguageData.LP_FortressCore.description: A Fortress Engineer's heart of the fortress: defensive buildings reinforced by engineers within radius 20 repair 5% per hour automatically. Once per raid, "full-line upgrade" can be triggered: all turrets in range (including rune turrets) get +30% damage for 1 hour. Only 1 per colony, and requires an engineer who knows "heart of the fortress" to build.
